pair.title: Connect to TrueNAS
pair.subtitle: Enter the address and API key of your NAS
pair.info: Create an API key in the TrueNAS web interface under Credentials → API Keys. The account behind the key needs read access, plus write access for the actions you want to use.
pair.hint_host: The local address of your TrueNAS, e.g. 192.168.1.50 or truenas.local.
pair.hint_api_key: Credentials → API Keys → Add in the TrueNAS web interface.
pair.hint_ignore_cert: TrueNAS uses a self-signed certificate by default. Leave this on unless you installed your own certificate.
pair.no_system: Add a TrueNAS system first, then add this device.
pair.err_host_required: Please enter a host name or IP address.

error.auth_failed: API key rejected. Check the key in TrueNAS under Credentials → API Keys.
error.no_websocket: This TrueNAS does not offer the JSON-RPC API. TrueNAS SCALE 25.04 or newer is required.
error.cert_rejected: The TLS certificate was rejected. Enable 'Accept self-signed certificate' in the device settings.
error.connection_refused: Connection refused. Check the address, port and protocol.
error.timeout: TrueNAS did not respond in time.
error.no_system: The TrueNAS system for this device no longer exists. Remove this device and add it again.
error.not_found: This entry no longer exists on the TrueNAS.
error.permission_denied: The API key lacks permission for this action.
error.boot_scrub_stop: A boot pool scrub cannot be stopped once it has started.
error.redirected: The NAS redirected the connection, which usually means it only accepts HTTPS. Turn on "Use HTTPS" in the device settings and set the port to 443.
error.host_not_found: The address could not be resolved. Homey often cannot look up .local names, so use the IP address of the NAS instead.
error.wrong_protocol: Protocol mismatch. If "Use HTTPS" is on, the port should normally be 443; if it is off, 80.
error.update_unsupported: Installing system updates needs TrueNAS SCALE 25.10 or newer. Install it in the TrueNAS web interface instead.
error.abort_unsupported: Only cloud sync tasks can be aborted. Replication and snapshot tasks have to run to completion.
